name: Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your head, shoulders, and entire torso smoothly up off the floor until you sit nearly upright over your hips.
Keep your feet grounded without jerking your body upward.
Unroll your spine slowly back down onto the floor with control before beginning the next repetition.
tips: Keep your chin slightly away from your chest throughout the curl.
Control the lowering phase all the way down rather than collapsing onto the floor.
